name: Die Langläufer
summary: Perith Stormhoof, a scout sent by Cairne Bloodhoof, is trapped at Bleachmane Rock after peace efforts with the gnolls turned violent. His escape matters to Cairne and the Tauren people.

sections.title: A Scout in Danger
sections.body: Cairne Bloodhoof sent Perith Stormhoof to make contact with the gnolls settled here. As one of Cairne’s Long Runners, Perith cannot speak of his full mission. The attempt at peace met with violence, and he fears the gnolls will eat him if he remains through the night. You are asked to help him escape Bleachmane Rock and report his safety to Cairne in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Cairne’s Thanks
sections.body: Cairne is relieved that Perith is safe. He calls the scout his most trusted and says the mission is of great importance. Cairne thanks you for risking your life to save him, saying you have done the Tauren people a greater service than you know.

faq.answer: Perith Stormhoof is one of Cairne Bloodhoof’s Long Runners, the chieftain’s scouts.

faq.q: Why is Perith at Bleachmane Rock?
faq.answer: Cairne sent Perith to make contact with the gnolls settled there, though Perith cannot discuss the full mission.

faq.q: What happened to the peace effort?
faq.answer: The gnolls answered the Long Runners’ attempt at peace with violence, leaving Perith in danger.

faq.q: What does Cairne ask me to do?
faq.answer: You are asked to help Perith escape Bleachmane Rock and tell Cairne in Thunder Bluff that he is safe.

angles.text: As a Tauren, you are helping Cairne Bloodhoof’s trusted scout, whose mission matters to the Tauren people.
